stories.title: Jamia ranks 183rd in QS Asia University Rankings 2027, up 14 places
stories.body: Jamia Millia Islamia has been placed 183rd in the QS Asia University Rankings 2027, up from 197th in the 2026 edition, according to a university press release dated Wednesday 4 November. The release says Jamia is 29th in Southern Asia. It states that QS published the rankings on Tuesday 3 November. The release is the university's own account of the result. The QS table itself was not opened in this run.
stories.check: Single source: the university's own release (6184). Confirm the rank and the 197th-to-183rd movement against the QS Asia 2027 table before publishing.

stories.title: Jamia law student wins advocacy award at national moot court in Rajasthan
stories.body: A Jamia Millia Islamia B.A. LL.B. student received the Advocacy Excellence Award at the 2nd Dr. S. S. Tantia National Moot Court Competition, 2026, according to a university press release dated Wednesday 4 November. The competition was organised by Tantia University in Sri Ganganagar, Rajasthan, on Saturday 24 and Sunday 25 October. The Jamia team had two other members, a speaker and a researcher. The release says the Dean of the Faculty of Law congratulated the team. It carries no detail on the final or on how many teams took part.
stories.check: Single source: the university's own release (6181). The release page returned a server error in this run; the details come from the PDF. Confirm with Jamia.
